name: Moero Downhill Night 2
original_name: 萌えろダウンヒルナイト２
source:
Akito, a young college student, has a fascination for racing games and spends all his spare money at the local arcade. His dream of being a racer is only that, a dream, until he met Rinka, a racer in her own right with the local Yotsuya Four Knights auto club.

One day, as she was showing off her car to Akita, a punk challenged Rinka to a driving battle, placing her ass as the prize. With her pride and body on the line, Akito must use his virtual-navigation skills in the real world and help her win the race. If Akito can keep his cool, it might be hot between him and Rinka, or with the other girls who've started to notice his skills as a race navigator.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/p017/]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
年轻大学生秋人痴迷赛车游戏，把所有闲钱都花在当地游戏厅。他梦想成为赛车手，但那始终只是梦想——直到他遇见本身就是车手、隶属当地Yotsuya Four Knights汽车俱乐部的凛香。

一天，凛香向秋人展示爱车时，一个混混向她发起赛车挑战，并把她的身体作为赌注。凛香的尊严与身体都押在这场比赛上，秋人必须把虚拟导航技巧运用到现实中，帮助她获胜。如果他能保持冷静，自己与凛香之间或许会迅速升温；其他开始注意到他导航才能的女孩也可能走进他的生活。

[摘自[url=https://jastusa.com/games/p017/]JAST USA[/url]]
